Messages.Author: Borrelstein
Messages.Body:
Ok so you really want that Brinksmanship oust? Quite a challenge!

Honestly this deck is going to be very slow, hence you need focus or the milling will not do anything. I think milling is good as a disruptive strategy against some decks (Anson!) but during a 2 hour game you would be lucky to mill through more than one library, and as you are slow you need to stay alive until the end game.

With this crypt you are unlikely to have vote majority at any table (adding big-caps without votes like Owain is not helping) to get Brinksmanship through. Perhaps it makes sense to include voting rather than bleeding as the secondary strategy, and add more intrinsic votes to the crypt, and the some push like private audience/telepathic vote counting. Indeed Dia de Los Muertos is a no-brainer for Brinksmanship.

Having Kyle as your biggest vamp slows everything down a lot, and you have no crypt acceleration. I also think the Harbingers in the crypt should be Egotha/Agaitas if you want milling, Gisela/Anisa does not accomplish any milling.

For the library, I would bring it down to 80 cards max and in particular cut the master section to <20. Take out the whole Parthenon/Therbold Realty/storage annex/protected resources module; it is better to have the locations you want (Slaughterhouse/Dia) faster instead of getting a master jam in the early game. Add Dreams of the Sphynx for crypt acceleration and cycling.

Hope this helps, good luck on your quest!

Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
Hello,
Slaughterhouses alone are not very good way of milling. They are relatively slow and you also need some way to get that one last card from your preys hand to force him/her to withdraw. Otherwise he/she can just sit with full hand ad infinitum. They probably won't win the game, but neither will you. And should you actually oust your first prey you have to start the process anew with each Methuselah.

If you really want to stick to Slaughterhouses, I second Borrelstein in adding a bunch of Revelations to your deck. Otherwise I suggest you going full wall and equipment based combat. Ditch most of your extra masters, Add 2-3 Constant revolution and equal amount of Smiling Jack. This will make you an enemy of entire table, but it's not such a leap as playing with Slaughterhouses as you already had two predators.

As for passing Brinksmanship, Dia de los Muertos is quite good. For low vote meta, couple of Telepathic Vote Counting combined with cardinal benediction and single Cryptic Rider is good plan B. If you go Cryptic Rider Route, some other vote than getting title might be better. Negotiating KRC to pass 2 to your prey and 2 to some other target should be quite easy.

I hope you can make this work

Sorry if my advice was not clear. You only need one anarch to play the Constant Revolution and only one sabbat to play Dia de los Muertos. I'd say you can stay mostly Sabbat, and mayby change in 2 anarch convert to crypt, dropping Marlene and Charice now that your not using dominate anymore. If you don't happen to draw your converts, no biggie just use the cardless action to go anarch with one vampire.

When I said equipment based combat, I meant guns, preferably .44/snipers. You will be doing so much blocking that transient combat will run out at some point.

Ventrue antitribu were dropped from crypt and replaced with AUS weenies and Anarch Converts, and one Gisella was returned to the crypt simply because she has title. I'm also tempted to remove cathedral and mask, but maybe you need them in your meta.

There is single prayer copy of Under Siege in library to increase block ability. This angle could be build upon by replacing Billy with Cicatriz. He has wrong disciplines but is only a 5 cap, has title and discard special to combo with Agaitas. Or if you feel you need more votes maybe that 5 cap Laibon magaji.
